title: isolved - Modular HCM platform sold directly and through a reseller partner network
clean_text: isolved People Cloud is a unified, modular HCM platform connecting HR, payroll, benefits, and workforce/talent management with built-in AI and analytics (HCM Intelligence), including autonomous AI agents for HR/payroll/benefits outcomes. More than 195,000 employers and 8 million employees use isolved's software and services. It primarily serves small-to-mid-size businesses valuing operational efficiency, and notably operates a large reseller network -- brokers, financial advisors, accountants, HR consultants, PEOs, ASOs, and payroll providers can resell isolved People Cloud under their own brand via the Preferred Partner program, supported by white-glove implementation services from local partners.

meta.target: small-to-mid-size businesses, distributed via reseller partner network
